title: C¹ gluing of a Whitney jet by a Whitney partition of unity
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), A ⊆ ℝⁿ closed, h : ℝⁿ → ℝ, and ν : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ continuous on A, and assume (W): for every compact K ⊆ A and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with |h(y) − h(x) − ⟨ν(x), y − x⟩| ≤ ε|y − x| for all x ∈ K and y ∈ A with 0 < |y − x| < δ. Let ι be a type, φ_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ and p_i ∈ ℝⁿ (i ∈ ι), and C ≥ 0, M ≥ 0 reals such that, with d(x) := dist(x, A): (P1) p_i ∈ A for all i; (P2) every φ_i is C¹ at every x ∉ A; (P3) φ_i(x) ≥ 0 for x ∉ A; (P4) every x ∉ A has a neighbourhood V and a finite s ⊆ ι with φ_i ≡ 0 on V for i ∉ s; (P5) Σᶠ_i φ_i(x) = 1 for x ∉ A; (P6) x ∉ A and φ_i(x) ≠ 0 imply |x − p_i| ≤ C·d(x); (P7) x ∉ A and d(x) ≤ 1 imply Σᶠ_i ‖Dφ_i(x)‖ ≤ M/d(x). If g : ℝⁿ → ℝ satisfies g(x) = h(x) for x ∈ A and g(x) = Σᶠ_i φ_i(x)(h(p_i) + ⟨ν(p_i), x − p_i⟩) for x ∉ A, then g is C¹ on ℝⁿ and Dg(x)v = ⟨ν(x), v⟩ for every x ∈ A and v ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n) (ι : Type) (φ : ι → Rn n → ℝ) (p : ι → Rn n) (C M : ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn ν A → (∀ K ⊆ A, IsCompact K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ A, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < δ → |h y - h x - inner ℝ (ν x) (y - x)| ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ M → (∀ i, p i ∈ A) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (φ i) x) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, 0 ≤ φ i x) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ s : Finset ι, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x, ∀ i ∉ s, ∀ y ∈ V, φ i y = 0) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∑ᶠ i, φ i x = 1) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, φ i x ≠ 0 → ‖x - p i‖ ≤ C * Metric.infDist x A) → (∀ x ∉ A, Metric.infDist x A ≤ 1 → ∑ᶠ i, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) x‖ ≤ M / Metric.infDist x A) → (∀ x ∈ A, g x = h x) → (∀ x ∉ A, g x = ∑ᶠ i, φ i x * (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i))) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ v, fderiv ℝ g x v = inner ℝ (ν x) v
